name: Goldfinch legacy Pool unauthenticated collectInterestRepayment
summary: The deprecated Goldfinch V1 Pool's collectInterestRepayment(from, amount) had no caller check: it pulls USDC from any address that approved the pool and adds it to the share price. The attacker flash-borrowed USDC, bought nearly all pool shares, pulled a stale approver's USDC in and withdrew the inflated shares; a copycat took the rest.
notes: Reset is setTotalFundsLimit raising the pool cap from 0, the last setting the exploit needed: deposit() requires poolWithinLimit, so no shares could be bought before it. The two later ProxyImplementationUpdated events re-set the same implementation and change no code.

Loss is gross per transaction (rule 11): the approver's USDC in the anchor plus the USDC the copycat took from the pool, most of which the anchor had stranded there. The 1,000 and 10,000 USDC deposits were flash-borrowed and withdrawn in the same transactions.
